Q2_K.desc: Smallest file. Noticeably lower quality. Good for testing.

Q3_K_M.desc: Very small. Some quality loss. Barely noticeable in most tasks.

Q4_K_M.desc: Balanced size and quality. The recommended default. Works on most GPUs.

Q5_K_M.desc: Larger file. Better math accuracy. Only if you have spare VRAM.

Q6_K.desc: Near full quality. Uses more VRAM. Only for high-end GPUs.

Q8_0.desc: Full quality, no quantization. Uses maximum VRAM. Rarely needed.

F16.desc: Full 16-bit precision. Highest quality. Uses maximum VRAM.

explanations.chat: This model handles everyday conversation well on your hardware. It picks up context across long chats and stays coherent.
explanations.coding: This model was trained or fine-tuned on code. It understands syntax, suggests implementations, and explains code better for your setup.
explanations.writing: This model has good context length for long documents, articles, and research. It maintains writing quality across {context}K token spans.
explanations.documents: This model has {context}K context - enough to load and analyze entire PDFs, transcripts, or codebases in one prompt.
explanations.agents: This model is capable of reasoning through multi-step agentic workflows and tool use effectively.
explanations.all: This model runs well on your hardware tier. It's versatile enough to handle chat, coding, writing, and document analysis.
